C12.falha_pt: Falácia do nirvana e apelo à natureza: de "não dá para zerar o dano" não se segue "tanto faz quanto dano causo", e "consciente" descreve quem mata, não o que acontece com quem morre

en.frase: We are animals and part of the ecosystem; no one lives without impact
formas: Thinking we're outside the cycle is an illusion
What matters is taking part in the cycle consciously
Every living thing feeds on another
en.falha: Nirvana fallacy and appeal to nature: "harm can't be brought to zero" doesn't mean "it makes no difference how much harm I cause", and "conscious" describes the one who kills, not what happens to the one who dies

D13.falha_pt: Confunde honrar as pessoas com repetir o que fizeram: cada geração revê práticas das anteriores, e julgar uma prática não é condenar quem a seguiu

en.frase: I don't want to dishonor my parents and my ancestors
formas: I have to respect my ancestors
Turning down my mother's food is disrespectful
My family has always lived this way; who am I to say they were wrong?
en.falha: Confuses honoring people with repeating what they did: every generation revises earlier practices, and judging a practice is not condemning those who followed it

E16.falha_pt: Apelo à autoridade e, em segunda mão, à maioria: a IA repete os textos com que foi treinada e é ajustada para não tomar partido; abster-se não é concluir que não é errado

en.frase: AIs say that not being vegan isn't wrong
formas: I asked ChatGPT and it said eating meat is a personal choice
Even artificial intelligence disagrees with you
AI is neutral, and it doesn't tell anyone to go vegan
en.falha: Appeal to authority and, at second hand, to the majority: AI repeats the texts it was trained on and is tuned not to take sides; abstaining is not concluding that it isn't wrong

H15.falha_pt: Falsa dicotomia: dá para escolher plantas e cuidar de como são cultivadas; o tipo de alimento pesa mais que o modo de produção, e nada disso responde ao que acontece com o animal

en.frase: What matters is how food is grown, not whether it comes from animals
formas: The focus should be the farming system, not the diet
What counts is the soil and the model of agriculture you fund
I'd rather have meat from a good farmer than soy from a monoculture
en.falha: False dichotomy: you can choose plants and care about how they are grown; the type of food weighs more than the production method, and none of it answers what happens to the animal

H16.falha_pt: A maior parte da soja e boa parte dos grãos alimentam animais de criação; comer plantas reduz a área agrícola, e comparar a pior lavoura com a melhor pecuária é injusto

en.frase: Plant monoculture destroys as much as industrial animal farming
formas: It's regenerative, local systems, with animals, that look after the land
Food sovereignty calls for animals integrated into the crops
A vegan world would be a soy desert
en.falha: Most soy and much of the grain feed farmed animals; eating plants reduces agricultural land, and comparing the worst cropland with the best animal farming is unfair
